summary: Diagnosed a blank Subagents panel caused by per-session id collisions (e.g. `sa-1`) that tripped Svelte duplicate-key checks, then rewrote `src/state.ts` to key state by session, scope reads to the active workspace, and evict stale entries from dead processes. Patched callers, runtime, and panel accordingly; added `state.test.ts`. `pnpm check` and the 11 subagent tests pass; web bundle rebuild and app reload are pending verification.
decisions: Key subagent state files by `sessionId` instead of `subagentId` so per-session ids like `sa-1` cannot collide across sessions and trigger Svelte duplicate-key warnings.
Scope `readMergedSubagentState` to the active workspace path so entries from other workspaces are filtered out before reaching the panel.
Evict subagent state files whose owning process is no longer alive (via `isProcessAlive` callback) to prevent dead-process entries from leaking into the snapshot.
Forward `sessionContext.cwd` into the subagent `toSubagentEntry` payload so each entry knows its originating workspace for filtering.
errors: Bash heredoc with a stray unescaped newline broke parsing when chaining `grep` after a here-doc; recovered by splitting into a separate command.
`Write` rejected overwriting `state.ts` until it was `Read` first; subsequent `Write` succeeded.
